Subject: Kickstart: Dedicated capacity playbook & MAP for CypherAI pilot

Hi Alicia (and CypherAI team),

Thanks again for the productive demo yesterday. To keep momentum, I wanted to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the dedicated capacity pilot we discussed — specifically capacity sizing, throughput targets, and the evaluation checklist that will drive the procurement timeline.

Attached: MAP-Playbook-v1.xlsx (playbook + milestone checklist). Also included an initial throughput profile CSV that Rishi will fill out with the benchmark numbers.

High-level goals for the MAP:
- Validate performance for your 5 production prompts under 500 req/s steady-state, with ~2x burst capability.
- Confirm end-to-end p95 latency SLOs and tail characteristics for 4k and 8k contexts.
- Agree on procurement timing (pilot billing vs reserved capacity) to hit a July production window.

Suggested internal owners (we can adjust):
- Technical evaluation & benchmarks: Rishi Malhotra (solutions) and Marissa Cole (inference lead)
- Customer success & rollout: Monica Patel
- Commercial / SOW and pricing: Markus Klein and Jordan Blake

Can you confirm the internal CypherAI stakeholders we should include (procurement contact, infra lead, security reviewer)? If the team agrees, I propose a 30m kickoff Thursday May 12, 10:00–10:30 PT to walk through the playbook and agree owners. I’ve tentatively created a calendar slot here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=cypherai-map-kickoff

Next steps I’ll cover in the kickoff: benchmark plan, sample prompts, success criteria for pilot, and the DocuSign SOW flow.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales (Redwood Inference)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Kickstart: Dedicated capacity playbook & MAP for CypherAI pilot

Alicia / team — quick technical note ahead of the kickoff and to give procurement a rough anchor. I’ll bring a filled throughput-profiles.csv to the meeting. Preliminary assumptions based on the demo prompts: 

- Target steady-state: 500 req/s (conversational single-turn workload, 2k avg tokens per session).
- Burst capability: up to 1,200 req/s for short windows (~30s) during peak events.
- Latency targets: p50 ~60–80ms, p95 <200ms for 2k contexts on a dedicated GPU pool with continuous batching and KV caching enabled.
- Cost guidance: pilot running on 4x A100-80GB equiv GPUs (quantized runtime where applicable) should land in the ballpark of $0.0008–$0.0012 / token delivered depending on batching and cache hit rate. We’ll aim to optimize below $0.0009 / token as a target for procurement review.

Recommended GPU pool options to discuss:
- Option A (latency-first): 4 x A100-80GB (reserved pool) — best p95 and headroom for KV cache.
- Option B (cost/throughput balance): 8 x A40 / L40 equivalents — better throughput scaling, slightly higher tail latency.

Marissa — can you own the benchmark runs and populate throughput-profiles.csv with the 5 prompt set? Please include: steady-state req/s at various batching configs, cache hit assumptions, and per-token measurement.

Markus / Jordan — I’ve included a short commercial anchor above. Markus, suggest we prepare a simple SOW template and a purchase commit tier that maps to the two hardware options so procurement has something concrete to evaluate.

A couple of attachments I’ll bring: throughput-profiles.csv (initial skeleton) and SLA-draft.pdf (SLA items we expect to negotiate).

Thanks — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — quick MAP summary and agreed owners before Thursday’s call (condensed):

MAP summary (milestones & owners):
- Benchmark kit + sample prompts delivered (owner: Marissa Cole) — due: 2027-05-16
- Evaluation window (CypherAI runs workloads, Redwood collects metrics) — 2027-05-17 to 2027-05-31
- Procurement review (SOW + commit options delivered) — owner: Markus Klein — due: 2027-06-07
- PO / Purchase decision (CypherAI procurement) — target: 2027-06-14
- Pilot start (dedicated pool active + monitoring) — target: 2027-06-21
- Production go-live (after pilot validation) — target: 2027-07-12

Success criteria (examples):
- Sustained steady-state throughput at 500 req/s with p95 latency <200ms for primary prompts.
- Cost-per-token within agreed pilot anchor (< $0.0009 token target).
- Integration of audit logs & retention per CypherAI security checklist.

Immediate asks for the kickoff:
1) Alicia / Samir: confirm the infra contact who will validate network and VPC peering requirements.
2) Procurement: confirm the PO cadence and any internal milestones required to circulate the SOW.
3) Marissa: prepare benchmark kit + attach throughput-profiles.csv to the shared Drive before the call.

I’ve attached the playbook and SLA draft for reference (MAP-Playbook-v1.xlsx, SLA-draft.pdf). We’ll walk these items in the 30m kickoff May 12 10:00 PT (calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=cypherai-map-kickoff). DocuSign SOW link will be ready for markups after the kickoff: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC-123-CY

Thanks everyone — looking forward to aligning on the plan and owners on Thursday.

Best,
